notes.title: Rogue Party 2 Scheduled Release: June 15, 2020
notes.notes:
Many of you know this already, but I lost the code for the original Rogue Party. I was devastated and took a break from making games.

But didn't last long, and I ended up using Unity this time around to make a much better sequel.

Thank you for buying my games and supporting an independent developer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274980/Rogue_Party_2/

notes.title: 6-4-2019 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33422551/faa7e50addcdb6854b7ba12e95e34e788dc3a15f.png[/img]

== Game Changes ==

[list]
[*] Pressing Escape will now reveal the stats on your equipment as well as provide the option to quit.
[*] Curse Cost set to 200 gold.
[*] Rerolling items now costs 150 gold and rerolls ALL your equipped items.
[*] Vampiric now restores 4 life up from 2 per kill.
[*] Poison now deals 50% more damage to enemies. No change for players.
[*] Mind controlled enemies now have their names show up like players' names to help distinguish them from the ones still trying to kill you.
[/list]

== Bugs Not Fixed ==

[list]
[*] Rain from the frost blade cloud is shown correctly now in multiplayer games.
[/list]

== Discord ==

[list]
[*] Join the conversation; Help shape the game and team up with your fellow rogues.
[*] DISCORD: https://discord.gg/NThERTU
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Gold Vendors and Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Tweaking:

Gold Vendor prices adjusted as well as gold drop rates.


Bug Fixes:

Killing the wizard will no longer cause your gold to drain back to what you had before your current run.

Legionnaires can no longer cast their shields while affected by a numbing potion.

notes.title: [New Patch is LIVE] Inferno Ring, Bonus Heart and Punchy Prefix Added
notes.notes:
== New Items ==
Unlock the Inferno Ring and Bonus Heart at 25 and 30 repeat boss kills.

Inferno Ring
Creates a zone which grants bonus damage to your attacks while you or your allies stand in it.

Bonus Heart
Adds 50 bonus life to your health pool. This extra life drains by 1 per second. You cannot have more than 50 bonus life at a time and appears as a blue heart to the right of your other hearts.

== New Prefix ==

Punchy is now available for all players. For each item with Punchy equipped you will have a whopping 15% chance on hit to knock back your opponent a short distance.

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/NThERTU

notes.title: Cursed Patch is LIVE!
notes.notes:
===Data Changes===
Cursed chance on all items reduced to 5% down from 10%.
Potion projectile speed increased by 20%.

===New Weapons===
Hand Axe: 17.5 Damage Per Second - flies on an arch
Serrated Arrows: 23.7 Damage Per Second - fastest projectile weapon

===Enhancements===
Valuable information regarding items you are deciding to pick up is now displayed above each chest.
Potions now splash with water of the same color as the bottle and glass shards.

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/NThERTU

notes.title: Update based on user feedback: Y-Axis Inversion Option
notes.notes:
You can now set the y-axis to normal or inverted.

Thank you for the community suggestion on the forums!

notes.title: Update and Suggestions Needed!
notes.notes:
- Bug Update -
Players should now properly leave lobbies upon quitting a game. If you see "player quit" repeatedly or cannot damage enemies in a multiplayer game please let me know. This was a rare and difficult to reproduce bug that is hopefully gone now.

- Chest Drops from Bosses -
Bosses now give you 1-9 chests. Enjoy!

- Content Update Suggestions -
Please let me know on the forums what you'd like added to the game for additional content. I am exploring several possibilities but your input is always welcome!

notes.title: New Patch: Menus
notes.notes:
The main menu has received some much needed love.

Unlocked magic items now show up with 3D models and an explanation of what they do.

Mouse speed has been doubled.

How to play font changed to yellow.

notes.title: "Shocking" Patch 1/11/2019
notes.notes:
-= New Prefix =-
A "Shocking" new prefix has been added to the game. It has a 33% chance to fire off a bolt of lightning when striking enemies. High damage but random patterns of attack.

-= New Item =-
Chaotic Bolts can now be unlocked for 20 repetetive boss kills. 8 second cooldown to fire two bolts of lightning that move in a consistent pattern.

-= FOV Option Added =-
You can now set the field of view (degrees) your character can see around them, from 45 default to 120.

-= Nerfed Proc'ing Prefixes =-
Prefixes that spawn bullets such as Shocking, Pyro and Homing no longer can proc off themselves. Sorry this was just way too OP, especially with Pyro.

notes.title: Game Update 1/6/2019
notes.notes:
New ENEMY: [u]Exploding Golem[/u]

   Watch out for this annoying monster on the levels immediately following the 
   first boss. Goblins in these zones have been replaced by Exploding Golems.

[u]Loading Screen[/u] is up and gives helpful hints to newer players.

[u]In Progress[/u]

   Double stats on some new powerful items.
   Better tutorial (pictures instead of text).
   More intelligent loading so you spend less time looking at a loading screen.

notes.title: Update - 12/26/2018 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-=New Default Items=-
Scythe
Titan Armor

-=New Unlockable Items=-
Relic - Aoe heal item best used for group healing.
Mayan Mine - Great trap for your enemies, especially melee opponents.
Doom Blade - Deals lots of damage right in front of you for six seconds.

-=New Prefix=-
Homing - 33% chance per item to launch a homing missle that does your weapon damage.

-=New Enemy=-
Lizardkin

-=Bug Fixes=-
Fixed volatile infection appearing on enemies that didn't have it applied.
(Hopefully) fixed most of the issues with homing shots doing little circles sometimes before launching at their target.

Loading screen added. Also fixed game crashing if you exit immediately after starting the game up.

notes.title: Wizard Boss Battle Patch
notes.notes:
New boss fight! Defeat the Wizard to earn his new rewards...

Wizard's Brain
Blast enemies and convert them to your side.

Wizard's Horn
Fly across the dungeon quickly while avoiding/breaking freeze effects.

Wizard's Eye
Spawn a floating Eyeball equipped with lots of firepower.

Wizard's Heart
Shoot a wave of bullets that heal you for the damage they deal to enemies.

notes.title: New Patch Soon - Wizard Boss Fight
notes.notes:
The next patch is nearly complete. It will include a new boss battle (finally the Wizard himself!) and four epic loot items rewarded for defeating him.

What I need next from YOU is any ideas you have for improvements on the game, suggestions for different modes of play, item ideas, enemy concepts, etc.

Leave a response here or on the forums and I will make an attempt to incorporate it to the base game prior to the first release ready version.

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Hell Has Arrived! Levels 11-15 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's New
=========
4 new enemies
4 new randomized levels
4 new bosses
6 new earnable items

Tweaks
======
Damage and reload times tweaked for most magical on use items.
Apprentice wand now always shoots daggers.
Upgraded Enemy AI.
Fear now works properly for all enemy types.
Knockback fixed in multiplayer.

Feedback on the new zone would be greatly appreciated. Playing through it I found the enemies to be too easy for a rogue with good gear so I buffed them 50%. Let me know if it's too much.

notes.title: Post Launch Patch (9/2/2018)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
=========
Teleporting in boss rooms will no longer send you outside of the level.
Magma Scale and Goblin Crown now look correct in multiplayer.

Updates
=========
Blood now spreads out on the ground and looks much cooler.
New Achievement: Frost Blade drops after the second time you kill the same boss.
New Upgrades allow you to decide which equipment is upgraded instead of always being random.
Bones and Guts from kills are now larger models.

What's Coming Next
==================
I am working on the third area of the game, Hell. This will come with 4 new bosses, 4 new enemies, potions, magic items and weapon prefixes.

If you have any ideas for game updates, achivement ideas, etc please let me know!
